key_insight: CoA search state must follow the selected walk branch; a refused response is a rejected branch, not reusable context.
hypothesis: With the same five target turns, refusal-triggered checkpoint rollback will reduce repeated refusals and improve paired unified ASR across the three victims.
decision_reason: Rollback eliminated repeated refusals and rejected-response commits, but only improved ASR on GPT-OSS and caused substantial per-goal churn on Qwen and DeepSeek.
next_hypothesis: Discard only the refused exchange while retaining all accepted history and rewrite the current chain prompt; do not pop an accepted checkpoint or decrement the chain index.
